the real ranking table IS present and IS real data: <table class="table table-record table-hover recordTale"><tbody> contains genuine rows (rank, player photo, KLPGA player profile link with real playerCode, player name, rating with up/down delta, two more numeric columns) -- e.g. rank 1 = 김민솔, rating 10.9047; rank 2 = 서교림, rating 9.4889 -- an EXACT match, player-for-player and value-for-value, to the operator-reported top-10 in KLPGA_KRANKING_2026_W36_TOP10_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_V1.json

the file's resource-path naming pattern ('k랭킹_files/') and the presence of full table markup with no visible AJAX week-label element strongly suggest this is a browser 'Save Page Complete' export of a client-side-rendered page, where the week/period label (if shown to a live viewer) is populated by a separate script/AJAX call whose response was not captured into this static HTML
kranking_import.conclusion: The raw file is authentic (hash-verified) and contains real, internally-consistent ranking data -- but it does not contain the ranking period/week label anywhere in its own text. Per explicit instruction, the week must never be inferred from the filename, the MANIFEST, or the operator's own prior partial-evidence transcription (which self-reports '2026년 36주차' but that claim lives outside this file, not inside it). Because script 87's fail-closed contract requires establishing the period from the source itself, this gate is BLOCKED -- HOME_PLAYER_MASTER_TOP120.json (currently ranking_week=2026-W35) is NOT updated by this import attempt.
kranking_import.not_fabricated: no ranking_week value was written or guessed anywhere as a result of this investigation
